description_text:
Photorealistic Posed 3D Animal Model
I have a passion for bringing reality to the digital realm. I'm intrigued and fascinated by the intricate details reality gives us and it is a pleasure being able to share these with you.
I use photogrammetry to 3D model the animal. The original is prepared by a Taxidermist.
A 3D posed animal is usefull in, for example, static renders, architectural visualization, Virtual Reality Natural History Museums, Games,...
Also, they can be used to explore and discover our biotope and family in an interactive scientific way using AR,VR and/or MR.
The model is Low Poly, has Quads only topology and an 8k (8192 by 8192px) texture map, as well as a 4k (4096 by 4096px) normal map. UV Map is clean only has a few Islands.
I hope you enjoy using this model as much as I had making it.
Thanks for your purchase!

description_text:
Photorealistic Posed 3D Animal Model
I have a passion for bringing reality to the digital realm. I'm intrigued and fascinated by the intricate details reality gives us and it is a pleasure being able to share these with you.
I use photogrammetry to 3D model the animal. The original is prepared by a Taxidermist.
A 3D posed animal is usefull in, for example, static renders, architectural visualization, Virtual Reality Natural History Museums, Games,...
Also, they can be used to explore and discover our biotope and family in an interactive scientific way using AR,VR and/or MR.
The model is Low Poly, has Quads only topology and an 8k (8192 by 8192px) texture map, as well as a 4k (4096 by 4096px) normal map. UV Map is clean only has a few Islands.
I hope you enjoy using this model as much as I had making it.
Thanks for your purchase!

description_text:
Photorealistic Posed 3D Animal Model
I have a passion for bringing reality to the digital realm. I'm intrigued and fascinated by the intricate details reality gives us and it is a pleasure being able to share these with you.
I use photogrammetry to 3D model the animal. The original is prepared by a Taxidermist.
A 3D posed animal is usefull in, for example, static renders, architectural visualization, Virtual Reality Natural History Museums, Games,...
Also, they can be used to explore and discover our biotope and family in an interactive scientific way using AR,VR and/or MR.

I hope you enjoy using this model as much as I had making it.
Thanks for your purchase!

description_text:
Digital sculpture of a Lion Anatomy.
General Features:
Includes detailed Skeleton and Muscular System.Includes the high-poly sculpted model in Zbrush, with subdivision levels.Includes Baked Normal Maps Textures.Includes UVs in 8 UDIMs.Also includes Face Muscles, although not visible in renders to also show the Skeleton.Low-Poly Version is 118972 Vertices.High-Poly Version is 26000000 Vertices.Includes also LowRes meshes (lowest subdivision level.)Can be used for 3D printingSculpted in real life scale 1:1.Included Files & Formats:
.ZPR (Zbrush 2020) – Sculpted meshes with subdivision levels.
.BLEND (Blender 2.82) – Render-Ready with materials
.OBJ – Low-Poly meshes
.PNG – Baked Normal Maps with UDIMs Setup
Notes:
This is a highpoly digital sculpture. The model includes UVs and Materials.This model was created by studying image references, mainly the Atlas of Animal Anatomy for Artists. This model was created with Zbrush 2020.The preview images were rendered with Blender Cycles. The .blend file includes a basic rendering setup: Geometry, Materials, Lights.The LowRes meshes were created using Zbrush’s Zremesh.

description_text:
Inspired by Mother Nature and many scientists, engineers and designers, the SpiderMex - pronounced Spider Mechz - is a sci-fi styled hexapod vehicle capable of carrying a single passenger. As with all high quality products designed by the Molek Corporation, the Poser version has all the features you'd find on the real thing. 

Including 6 fully articulated legs, each of which has a full range of natural movement. Such as: Up/Down, Left/Right, Forward/Rear. It's this range of articulation which provides hexapods with the ability to be stable anywhere and to operate even when one leg is disabled. 

Which also means the SpiderMex is incredibly flexible in terms of the poses that can be quickly created for your 3d scenes. From bunching up all legs for ease of transportation, to partially extending the leg parts to easily stand on unlevelled terrain, or fully extending all the legs. 

The 2 Arms, have hands and wrists that have the ability to rotate and twist.

This model also features an air-conditioned NBC-sealed cab with opening/closing door, detailed engine, seat with controls, plus a Lightbar.   

The textures: Default Olive Army Green, Navy Grey and Police "Protect & Inject" also reflect some of the wide variety of roles from the Space Marines, asteroid mining through to urban policing that the SpiderMex has undertaken. 

Carefully designed UVMapping means that the core body textures can easily be replaced with app specific shaders or a single map within seconds. The rear pod also contains a separate material zone so you can easily change this to a material or shader which glows, which can give the SpiderMex a sense of menace. Or you can create your own with the included templates. All of which gives you the artist loads of opportunity for creating unique variations.  

Product Features (Wavefront OBJ):
- Approx 115510 polygons.
- All of the leg sections, arm sections, and hood/ canopy are separate groups, which your software should read as separate parts.
- This version includes an mtl file, which your software program should read to colorize the model.
- The model is UV mapped and textures (in jpg format) are included.

Three obj/ mtl models are included with each texture scheme already set:
- Olive Army Green
- Navy Grey
- Police Blue

Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
12 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 29654 vertices, 29632 quad faces (59264 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

description_text:
Telescope 3D Model, nr. 2 in my collection. 9 individual objects (so you can easily rotate or even animate them), sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures sets. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
9 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 115335 vertices, 113715 quad faces (227430 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
A set of 13 laboratory glasses 3D Models, sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Materials (glasses, liquids) and PBR Textures set. Beaker, Boiling tube, Claisen flask, Conical Erlenmeyer flask, Filter funnel, Florence flask, Kjedahl flask, Pear shaped flask, Round bottomed flask, Test tube glass, Thistle funnel glass, Volumetric flask, Volumetric pipette. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
24 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 126005 vertices, 125832 quad faces (251664 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
DNA molecules 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 411082 vertices, 408512 quad faces (817024 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Sci-Fi Console with PBR textures for games. Retro style design.
This is original concept design not based in any known real world device. This is great for games and this asset can be used a interactive console. This has enough detail to be rendered from close distances.
Renders are made using Marmoset Toolbag.
Mostly quads. 3652 polys with 3388 quads and 264 tris. No co-planar faces or isolated vertices. FBX file and Blender file has correct, real world scale. FBX file was tested in Unreal Engine (please see the screenshot)
4K PBR textures in PNG format using Metal-Roughness PBR workflow. Emissive map was used for green lights. I have also included packed version of the textures that is optimised for Unreal Engine 4. Please find it in the supporting items section of this site.
This model is intended to be used in realtime apps which support baked normal maps and PBR. Normal map was baked from high poly model using Substance Painter with Mikk-T space calculation. Please notice that the baked normal map may not render correctly in applications such as Max. The curvature and detail of this model relies heavily in normal map due to this being a low poly model.
The text 'Nakajima Aerospace Industries' is my own invention and not any real world brand as far as I know.

description_text:
cuboidal epithelium model as two separate objects

  - simple cuboidal

  - Stratified cuboidal.The formats 3mf, ply, obj, USDZ,GLTZ & GLB with applied uv mapped textures have also been included in the downloads along with  stl.

I have included the various formats needed by various customer for the various 3d modelling softwares they may be using. The following formats are compressed in rar formats :-

  -  blend

  -  3mf

  -  stl

  - obj

  - glb

  - gltz

  - usdzThe downloaded files have to unpacked using any rar unpacker. After unpacking, the folder content of the respective formats will be as follows :-.

  - blend :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  - 3mf :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  - stl :- single file with only geometry data

  - obj :- mutiple files including .obj,.mtl, images textures.

  - glb :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  - gltz :- mutiple files including .bin, images textures.

  - usdz :- single file 

The native file is blend so the open source software blender opens mostly all the files, with textures (packed with the files). The best way is to open the files named blend with blender. Other files have to be imported in blender by clicking within blender File >>Import>>select the type of file you want to import>>open file location of the downloaded unzipped files>>select the file>>the model would open in the 3d viewport of the software.The other files including blender can be opened with most of the free and paid 3d modelling software. The files obj & fbx are compatible with other 3d modeling software, example maya. These software's have the open/import options similar to blender. The files stl and 3mf are compatible with 3d printing software's. The built in3d builder " windows software opens all of these files including glb, & gltz. In case you don't have 3d builder installed just download it free from Microsoft store for free. For 3d builder 3mf, fbx, stl, glb are standalone files (right click the model file>>select open with>>3d builder). For obj,ply, & gltz 3d builder will prompt you to select the model files .mtl and image textures (these are packed in the rar files).The textures files have been separately supplied additionally; in case one needs them.

description_text:
red blood cell normal abnormal.
red blood cells in various anaemia.The formats 3mf, ply, obj, fbx, USDZ,GLTZ & GLB with applied uv mapped textures have also been included in the downloads along with  stl.
I have included the various formats needed by various customer for the various 3d modelling softwares they may be using. The following formats are compressed in rar formats :-

  -  blend

  -  3mf

  -  stl

  -  obj

  -  fbx

  -  glb

  -  gltz

  -  usdzThe downloaded files have to unpacked using any rar unpacker. After unpacking, the folder content of the respective formats will be as follows :-.

  -  blend :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  3mf :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  stl :- single file with only geometry data

  -  obj :- mutiple files including .obj,.mtl, images textures.

  -  fbx :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  glb :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  gltz :- mutiple files including .bin, images textures.

  -  usdz :- single file 

The native file is blend so the open source software blender opens mostly all the files, with textures (packed with the files). The best way is to open the files named blend with blender. Other files have to be imported in blender by clicking within blender File >>Import>>select the type of file you want to import>>open file location of the downloaded unzipped files>>select the file>>the model would open in the 3d viewport of the software.The other files including blender can be opened with most of the free and paid 3d modelling software. The files obj & fbx are compatible with other 3d modeling software, example maya. These software's have the open/import options similar to blender. The files stl and 3mf are compatible with 3d printing software's. The built in3d builder " windows software opens all of these files including glb, & gltz. In case you don't have 3d builder installed just download it free from Microsoft store for free. For 3d builder 3mf, fbx, stl, glb are standalone files (right click the model file>>select open with>>3d builder). For obj,ply, & gltz 3d builder will prompt you to select the model files .mtl and image textures (these are packed in the rar files).The textures files have been separately supplied additionally; in case one needs them.

description_text:
3d model of ear in cross section  depicting detailed labelled anatomy. the model is uploaded in max and blend files with textures.The formats 3mf, ply, obj, fbx, USDZ,GLTZ & GLB with applied uv mapped textures have also been included in the downloads along with  stl.
I have included the various formats needed by various customer for the various 3d modelling softwares they may be using. The following formats are compressed in rar formats :-

  -  blend

  -  3mf

  -  stl

  -  obj

  -  fbx

  -  glb

  -  gltz

  -  usdzThe downloaded files have to unpacked using any rar unpacker. After unpacking, the folder content of the respective formats will be as follows :-.

  -  blend :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  3mf :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  stl :- single file with only geometry data

  -  obj :- mutiple files including .obj,.mtl, images textures.

  -  fbx :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  glb :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  gltz :- mutiple files including .bin, images textures.

  -  usdz :- single file 

The native file is blend so the open source software blender opens mostly all the files, with textures (packed with the files). The best way is to open the files named blend with blender. Other files have to be imported in blender by clicking within blender File >>Import>>select the type of file you want to import>>open file location of the downloaded unzipped files>>select the file>>the model would open in the 3d viewport of the software.The other files including blender can be opened with most of the free and paid 3d modelling software. The files obj & fbx are compatible with other 3d modeling software, example maya. These software's have the open/import options similar to blender. The files stl and 3mf are compatible with 3d printing software's. The built in3d builder " windows software opens all of these files including glb, & gltz. In case you don't have 3d builder installed just download it free from Microsoft store for free. For 3d builder 3mf, fbx, stl, glb are standalone files (right click the model file>>select open with>>3d builder). For obj,ply, & gltz 3d builder will prompt you to select the model files .mtl and image textures (these are packed in the rar files).The textures files have been separately supplied additionally; in case one needs them.

description_text:
This is a futuristic flying battle-drone that can extend and retract its guns. I was ispired by the flying drone from the movie Oblivion with Tom Cruise, Morgan Freeman and Andrea Riseborough.
=======================================================================================
I made this model with Blender but it is available in 4 different formats, so everyone can use it:
.obj.fbx.blend.dae
======================================================================================= 
The Blender file includes the object with a SubdivisionSurface modifier added and a PBR-Material for every Object (the one I used for the thumbnail and preview pictures).
For the rest of you, who is using a different Software: The model already got holding-edges so you can subdivide it without a problem BUT since I made everything in Blender, all other formats don't include a Material. But I packed all textures into the download folder. 
I recommend to subdivide the model to make it look more realistic.
Vertices: 172.406
=======================================================================================
I hope you like it! Have a nice day!

description_text:
This realistic Lightning 3D model is crafted to blend seamlessly in any kind of background environment and renders very fast.
The mesh is optimized for low polycount and can also be used in games.
Polygons:7876Vertices:7910
The Lightning geometry is made in real world scale ~ 8km height (which is the average height of this type of Cloud to Ground Lightning), but can be scaled up or down to fit your needs and will still look good in renders.Scene units - m (meters).
This is a V-Ray version.If you are using other renderer you will be able to use the geometry, but will have to make/use your own materials.
Every branch can be easily selected (by Element) in case you want to animate different illumination and/or timings per branch (as it happens in real world) for some spectacular slow motion animations.
All elements are UVW Unwrapped without overlapping just in case you need to use textures. Current one uses Vertex Color (which can be baked to texture if needed) and is embedded in the exported FBX format too (can be baked in Substance Designer, etc.).
Feel free to adjust the brightness of the light materials to best match your scene and camera settings. They are properly named and easy to set, separated by branch size.
The glow of the main bolt is made via V-Ray Lens effects Bloom + Glare (which is set up in the scene) and can be turned off if you want to add your own effects in post.
Rendered on black background the lightning will be perfect to blend in your image via 'Screen' or 'Lighten' mode in PhotoShop, AffinityPhoto, etc.
The geometry can also be used as a light source when merged in your scene. You can adjust only the main bolt strength as it is the brightest and most influential.Make sure to check out a related V-Ray rendering tip included with this product as .jpg and .txt files.

description_text:
A 1:1 scale model of vertebral column bone and cartilage The material has image textures and normal maps in non overlapping UVs.Excellent model for displaying vertebral column anatomy along with text label of bone names (orange) and its part (blue).The formats 3mf, ply, obj, fbx, USDZ,GLTZ & GLB with applied uv mapped textures have also been included in the downloads along with  stl.
I have included the various formats needed by various customer for the various 3d modelling softwares they may be using. The following formats are compressed in rar formats :-

  -  blend

  -  3mf

  -  stl

  -  obj

  -  fbx

  -  glb

  -  gltz

  -  usdzThe downloaded files have to unpacked using any rar unpacker. After unpacking, the folder content of the respective formats will be as follows :-.

  -  blend :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  3mf :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  stl :- single file with only geometry data

  -  obj :- mutiple files including .obj,.mtl, images textures.

  -  fbx :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  glb :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  gltz :- mutiple files including .bin, images textures.

  -  usdz :- single file 

The native file is blend so the open source software blender opens mostly all the files, with textures (packed with the files). The best way is to open the files named blend with blender. Other files have to be imported in blender by clicking within blender File >>Import>>select the type of file you want to import>>open file location of the downloaded unzipped files>>select the file>>the model would open in the 3d viewport of the software.The other files including blender can be opened with most of the free and paid 3d modelling software. The files obj & fbx are compatible with other 3d modeling software, example maya. These software's have the open/import options similar to blender. The files stl and 3mf are compatible with 3d printing software's. The built in3d builder " windows software opens all of these files including glb, & gltz. In case you don't have 3d builder installed just download it free from Microsoft store for free. For 3d builder 3mf, fbx, stl, glb are standalone files (right click the model file>>select open with>>3d builder). For obj,ply, & gltz 3d builder will prompt you to select the model files .mtl and image textures (these are packed in the rar files).The textures files have been separately supplied additionally; in case one needs them.

low poly modeltexture :    fleas color. 2048x2048    fleas normal map. 2048x2048
Flea, the common name for the order Siphonaptera, includes 2,500 species of small flightless insects that survive as external parasites of mammals and birds. Fleas live by consuming blood or hematophagy, from their hosts. Adult fleas grow to about 3 mm or .12 in long, are usually brown, and have bodies that are flattened sideways, or narrow, enabling them to move through their host's fur or feathers. They lack wings, but have strong claws preventing them from being dislodged; mouthparts adapted for piercing skin and sucking blood, and hind legs extremely well adapted for jumping. They are able to leap a distance of some 50 times their body length, a feat second only to jumps made by another group of insects, the superfamily of froghoppers. Fleas' larvae are worm-like with no limbs; they have chewing mouthparts and feed on organic debris left on their host's skin.

Thumbnails are rendered with level 2 subdivision: this includes the wireframe images as well as those displaying the included texture maps.
Try different color combinations over the texture maps, we've found it's hard to go wrong with an octopus!
Included textures: displacement map, normal map, reflect map

  - Polygons (without triangulation): 750

  - Vertices: 752

Available File Formats: .blend .obj .3ds .x3d .fbx .stl .abc .dae .glb
[the .dae, .abc, .x3d, and .obj files are available in triangulated and non-triangulated versions]
